scope: Four native candidate builds: release/fastdebug on Linux ARM and Windows x64. Build receipts verify actual JVM SOURCE independently of the workflow revision. This draft does not run tests, controls, CDS repetitions or performance and cannot close any native qualification gap.
publication: If explicitly approved, overlay these workflow files only on the existing evidence branch, preserving its other content; dispatch its existing main.yml workflow manually on that branch. The default branch and PR source do not need to change. Parent approval is still required.
review_data_publication: This directory may be preserved as inert data below .github/qualification/chain-checkpoint; that does not install a workflow or authorize a hosted run.
